title: Draw a Cat
steps: Sketch a circle for the head and an oval for the body.
Add triangle ears and light guidelines for the face.
Draw simple eyes, nose, mouth, and whiskers.
Add legs and a curved tail.
Darken final lines and erase guides.
tips: Keep your first lines light so they are easy to erase.

title: Draw a Fish
steps: Draw a sideways oval for the fish body.
Add a triangle tail connected to the oval.
Sketch top and bottom fins.
Draw a small eye and curved smile.
Add scales with light repeating arcs.
tips: Repeat simple shapes for scales instead of aiming for perfect detail.

title: Draw a Panda
steps: Draw a large circle for the panda head.
Add two round ears and a small oval snout.
Draw big eye patches and place eyes inside.
Sketch a rounded body and short limbs.
Fill the ears, eye patches, and limbs with dark shading.
tips: Use soft shading to create fluffy fur texture.

title: Draw a Simple House
steps: Draw a square for the main house shape.
Add a triangle roof on top.
Sketch a centered door and two windows.
Draw roof lines and a chimney.
Add ground, path, and simple details.
tips: Use a ruler if you want neat straight lines.

title: Draw a Rocket
steps: Draw a tall capsule shape for the rocket body.
Add side fins near the bottom.
Sketch a circular window near the top.
Draw flame shapes under the rocket.
Add stars or clouds for a fun background.
tips: Mirror the left and right fins to keep the rocket balanced.

title: Draw a Bicycle
steps: Draw two equal circles for the wheels.
Connect wheels with a triangular frame.
Add handlebars, seat, and front fork.
Sketch pedals and chain area.
Refine with spokes and erase extra guidelines.
tips: Measure spacing between wheels first for better proportions.

title: Draw a Friendly Robot
steps: Draw a square head and rectangle body.
Add circular eyes and a simple smile.
Sketch tube-like arms and legs.
Add antenna and chest buttons.
Outline and color metallic sections.
tips: Use repeated geometric shapes to keep the robot design consistent.

title: Draw a Cartoon Dragon
steps: Sketch a curved line for the dragon spine.
Add a rounded head with horns and snout.
Draw a plump body and four short legs.
Add wings using triangle-like membranes.
Finish with tail spikes and light shading.
tips: Keep the body simple first, then add fantasy details last.

title: Draw an Astronaut
steps: Draw a circle helmet and visor shape.
Sketch a small body suit under the helmet.
Add gloves, boots, and backpack.
Draw suit seams and panel details.
Add stars and a moon background.
tips: Round corners on the suit to make it look padded.

title: Draw a Butterfly
steps: Draw a thin body line with a small head.
Sketch two large top wings.
Add two smaller bottom wings.
Draw mirrored patterns on both sides.
Color with bright gradients and dots.
tips: Fold the wing layout mentally in half to keep both sides symmetrical.

title: Draw a Coffee Mug
steps: Draw an oval for the mug opening.
Extend two vertical sides downward.
Close the bottom with a curved line.
Add a C-shaped handle on one side.
Draw steam lines and simple shading.
tips: Keep top and bottom curves parallel for a realistic cup form.

title: Draw a Cute Fox
steps: Draw a rounded triangle for the fox head.
Add pointy ears and fluffy cheek lines.
Sketch almond eyes and a tiny nose.
Draw a sitting body and bushy tail.
Color orange and leave tail tip white.
tips: Use short strokes around cheeks and tail for fluffy texture.
